conjunction_note_on_eligibility.rule: Sealed D2 eligibility requires BOTH B1 declination and B3 date. A run whose date lies outside the sealed window is D2 ineligible on B3 regardless of its declination.
conjunction_note_on_eligibility.consequence: Runs R-01, R-02, R-18 and R-19 are D2_SPATIAL_INELIGIBLE_BY_DATE_CONJUNCTION without needing a declination read. This is the sealed conjunction, not a shortcut: no declination value could make them eligible.
conjunction_note_on_eligibility.what_still_requires_reading: The 15 runs inside the sealed date window require the printed per-row declination to be read and tested for within-run constancy, then transformed and compared.

warning_against_the_available_extrapolat.temptation: The header settings step from -24 40 to -26 40 across the window, and the one row value read so far sat about 50 arcminutes south of its run's setting. Combining the two would predict which runs fall inside B1.
warning_against_the_available_extrapolat.refusal: That inference is refused. The relationship between setting and printed row value is not understood, and this project has already had to correct one shortcut of exactly this shape today. The row values will be read.
